{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed['revenue'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = completed[completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Print the number of QA orders and their revenue
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed group: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'QA order revenue: {qa_orders["revenue"].iloc[0] if len(qa_orders) > 0 else None}')

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA orders)
mean_revenue_clean = completed[completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]['revenue'].mean()

# Print the cleaned mean
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue_clean}')"}
